run_moge_depth_estimation: run the MoGe model on all scenes in a dataset to predict depth, mask, and normals
run_moge_on_scene: run the MoGe model on a single scene to generate depth maps and masks
load_moge_model: load a pretrained MoGe model from a given path onto a specified device
review_run_moge_on_scene: review the run_moge_on_scene function that processes batches of frames through the MoGe model
review_load_model: review the load_model function that loads a MoGeModel from pretrained weights
